warRoom.title: Competitor War Room
warRoom.subtitle: Turn competitor scenarios into a playable strategy sandbox with budget, counter-moves, risk exposure, and market-share decisions.
warRoom.creatorBacklashDesc: Influencer reaction turns against the campaign
warRoom.budgetWarDesc: A rival floods paid media and retail visibility
warRoom.strategyProofDesc: Add evidence, testimonials, and claim discipline.
warRoom.strategyPriceMatchDesc: Defend conversion without turning the whole market into discounting.
warRoom.strategyCreatorDesc: Use trusted creators and social proof to reclaim attention.
warRoom.strategyDefensiveDesc: Hold spend, reduce claims, and prepare crisis response.
warRoom.eventPriceCutImpact: Competitor B cut price by 20%, starting a price war.
warRoom.eventMarginPressureImpact: Discount fatigue appears. CFO and sales teams push back on margin erosion.
warRoom.eventNewProductImpact: Our innovation launched first and market share jumped.
warRoom.eventCopycatImpact: Competitor Y copied our product and diluted the advantage.
warRoom.eventScandalImpact: Big Competitor faced a labor scandal and boycott pressure.
warRoom.eventApologyImpact: The competitor starts recovery messaging and wins back some undecided buyers.
warRoom.eventInfluencerBacklashImpact: A creator challenges the campaign claim and pushes negative comments into mainstream feeds.
warRoom.eventCreatorRepairImpact: A proof-led creator wave and FAQ content recover trust among high-intent audiences.
warRoom.eventMediaBlitzImpact: A high-spend rival dominates paid media and retail placements early.
warRoom.eventFatigueImpact: Audience fatigue lowers rival efficiency and rewards clearer differentiated messaging.
warRoom.vulnerabilityMargin: Weakness: margin pressure and discount fatigue.
warRoom.vulnerabilityTrust: Weakness: weaker proof and lower brand trust.
warRoom.vulnerabilityOriginality: Weakness: copycat risk and low originality.
warRoom.vulnerabilityAwareness: Weakness: low awareness outside niche buyers.
warRoom.vulnerabilityScale: Weakness: limited scale under high attention.
warRoom.vulnerabilityPremium: Weakness: cannot credibly attack premium value.
warRoom.vulnerabilityProof: Weakness: audience asks for evidence quickly.
warRoom.vulnerabilityEfficiency: Weakness: paid media efficiency drops under fatigue.
warRoom.vulnerabilityMessage: Weakness: retail message is easy to copy.
warRoom.playbookRound1Reason: Define the claim, segment, and channel where we want the fight to happen.
warRoom.playbookMidReason: Protect the highest-value segment without copying every competitor move.
warRoom.playbookLateReason: Use evidence from early rounds to move spend toward the strongest response.
warRoom.playbookScaleReason: Move only if share gain beats crisis exposure and competitor retaliation.
warRoom.decisionScaleReason: {brand} gains {shift} share points with projected conversion at {conversion}%. Expand budget, but keep response monitoring active.
warRoom.decisionContainReason: Crisis risk is {risk}% with estimated exposure of {exposure}. Tighten claims and response plan first.
warRoom.decisionPilotReason: Share movement is {shift} points with projected conversion at {conversion}%. Validate one sharper counter-move before full spend.
warRoom.recommendContain: Pause broad spend and run crisis containment
warRoom.recommendContainSummary: The market-share upside is not strong enough to justify the current reputational exposure.
warRoom.recommendAttack: Push the advantage while the competitor is exposed
warRoom.recommendAttackSummary: The simulation shows enough share gain to justify a controlled offensive play.
warRoom.recommendPilotSummary: The game is still winnable, but the next move needs sharper evidence or segment targeting.
warRoom.actionCrisisCell: Create a 24-hour crisis response cell with approved holding statements.
warRoom.actionRewriteClaim: Rewrite the riskiest claim and add proof before the next media burst.
warRoom.actionHoldSpend: Hold broad paid spend until risk falls below the agreed threshold.
warRoom.actionIncreaseBudget: Increase budget in the two strongest channels for one sprint.
warRoom.actionLockCreators: Lock trusted creators and customer testimonials before the rival responds.
warRoom.actionMonitorCompetitor: Monitor price, creator, and PR counter-moves daily.
warRoom.actionRetestMessage: Retest the message against the most price-sensitive and trust-sensitive personas.
warRoom.actionSegmentOffer: Create a segment-specific offer instead of a market-wide discount.
warRoom.actionPrepareCounter: Prepare a competitor counter-brief for the next simulated round.
